turkiye_competitors.name: Judex Enterprise
turkiye_competitors.reason: AI sistemlerine yönelik kontrol kütüphanesi, mevzuat referansları, bağlı kanıtlar ve denetime hazır uyum raporları; önerilen kanıt paketi iş akışını karşılıyor.

global_competitors.name: Credo AI
global_competitors.reason: Control library and compliance policy mapping, governance workflows, approvals and audit-ready evidence for enterprise AI programs.

global_competitors.name: IBM watsonx.governance
global_competitors.reason: Collects governance enforcement evidence and agent evaluation metrics, providing traceable controls against policies.

adjacent_competitors.name: PolicyGate
adjacent_competitors.reason: Primarily in-line runtime policy enforcement with cryptographic event logs, rather than owner attestations and review calendar.

results.market_gap: No substantiated unmet control-evidence collection or audit export gap against direct local/global products.
results.mvp: AI control library, control owners, scheduled evidence requests, sign-offs, exception closure, CSV/PDF audit export.
results.working_logic: Define controls -> assign owners -> collect/upload evidence -> reviewer checks -> close exceptions -> export audit pack.
results.marketing_strategy: Not recommended without specific niche differentiation.
results.first_customer_plan: No pilot until finding unmet regulatory/control-ownership workflow not supported by Credo AI, AuditBase, Judex.
results.main_risk: Strong global enterprise GRC incumbents plus Turkish specialist equivalents.
results.validation_assumption: Simple evidence pack workflow could differentiate on lower price, but this is not proof of distinct core job.
results.local_applicability_rationale: Worldwide AI governance buyer rather than Lüleburgaz local sector.
results.rejection_reason: Credo AI and IBM globally, AuditBase and Judex in Türkiye already support enterprise AI control governance and audit evidence workflow, without proven differentiated buyer/job. IBM's source is Aug 11 rather than Oct 8.
results.review_notes: A competitor count is confirmed identified examples, not a complete market census. Zero external cash cost and build-credit estimate are unverified but independent from competition rejection.

research_scope_note: Candidate 26 independently assessed against primary vendor product pages; remaining 27-30 not yet concluded.
